label: Atrahasis Epic
subtitle: Akkadian literary work
description: A Mesopotamian composition containing a flood narrative; surviving witnesses and later literary relationships require separate study.

label: Epic of Gilgamesh
subtitle: Akkadian epic tradition
description: A composite Mesopotamian epic whose Standard Babylonian version includes Uta-napishti's flood account.

label: Torah / Pentateuch
subtitle: Hebrew scriptural collection
description: The five-book Torah includes the Genesis flood narrative; comparison does not by itself establish a transmission route.

label: Plato — Phaedo
subtitle: Greek philosophical dialogue
description: A dialogue about Socrates' final hours that develops arguments concerning the soul and death.

label: Bhagavad Gita
subtitle: Sanskrit dialogue within the Mahabharata
description: A dialogue between Arjuna and Krishna treating duty, disciplined action, knowledge, devotion, and the self.

label: 1 Enoch
subtitle: Second Temple Jewish composite work
description: An ancient Jewish composite work preserved completely in Geʽez and quoted in the Letter of Jude.

label: Catholic Epistles
subtitle: New Testament letter collection
description: A catalog grouping that includes the Letter of Jude; the cited relationship concerns Jude 14b–15 specifically.

label: Ethiopian Enoch tradition
subtitle: Geʽez preservation and reception context
description: A research record for the Geʽez transmission and Ethiopian reception of 1 Enoch, separate from any one manuscript or English edition.

label: Ethiopic Qeddase tradition
subtitle: Geʽez liturgical tradition
description: A metadata record for a continuing liturgical tradition; it is not a claim that every community uses an identical recension.

label: Dǝggʷa associated with Saint Yared
subtitle: Geʽez hymnographic tradition
description: A Geʽez hymnographic record modeled separately from church identity and from individual physical witnesses.

label: Lotus Sutra
subtitle: Mahāyāna Buddhist scripture
description: A scripture central to Tiantai interpretation and practice.

label: Profound Meaning of the Lotus Sutra
subtitle: Tiantai exegetical work
description: A Tiantai interpretive work associated with Zhiyi's exposition of the Lotus Sutra.

label: Gospel of Matthew
subtitle: New Testament gospel
description: One of the three Synoptic Gospels and a later object of both commentary and polemical reception.

label: Gospel of Mark
subtitle: New Testament gospel
description: One of the three Synoptic Gospels; its source relationship to Matthew and Luke remains a scholarly problem with competing hypotheses.

label: Gospel of Luke
subtitle: New Testament gospel
description: One of the three Synoptic Gospels; models of its sources must retain the live scholarly alternatives.

label: The Satanic Bible
subtitle: Modern religious literature
description: A copyrighted modern work represented by metadata and an official public statement rather than reproduced text.

label: Instruction of Amenemope
subtitle: Ancient Egyptian wisdom instruction
description: An Egyptian wisdom composition frequently studied alongside Proverbs 22:17–23:11.

label: Proverbs
subtitle: Hebrew wisdom collection
description: A composite wisdom collection whose relationship to Egyptian instruction literature is studied at the level of particular sections.

label: Book of the Dead
subtitle: Ancient Egyptian funerary composition tradition
description: A modern collective title for variable ancient Egyptian funerary compositions, not one invariant book.

label: Opening of the Mouth Ritual
subtitle: Ancient Egyptian ritual-text tradition
description: A ritual complex associated with animation and funerary practice, modeled separately from the Book of the Dead.

label: Mawangdui Laozi silk manuscripts
subtitle: Early Laozi textual witnesses
description: Silk-text witnesses from Mawangdui that predate the received ordering and illuminate textual variation.

label: Tao Te Ching / Daodejing
subtitle: Received Laozi textual tradition
description: The received textual tradition associated with Laozi; early witnesses differ in sequence and wording.

label: Spring and Autumn Annals
subtitle: Chinese chronicle
description: A concise chronicle transmitted with major commentary traditions.

label: Zuo Commentary
subtitle: Commentary and narrative tradition
description: A major commentary and narrative tradition transmitted in relation to the Spring and Autumn Annals.

label: Hebrew / Jewish traditions
subtitle: Nonexclusive Atlas tradition grouping
description: A broad discovery grouping that must not replace period-specific Jewish communities or texts.

label: Christian traditions
subtitle: Nonexclusive Atlas tradition grouping
description: A broad discovery grouping whose early textual relationships require period-specific evidence.

label: George Washington
description: Historical person with documented Masonic membership and documented correspondence about claims concerning the Illuminati.

label: Adam Weishaupt
subtitle: Founder associated with the Bavarian Illuminati
description: Historical person linked to the documented eighteenth-century Bavarian organization; this record makes no claim about later namesakes.

label: Freemasonry
subtitle: Documented fraternal organization family
description: A historically documented fraternity with jurisdiction-specific lodges and records, not a single centralized world organization.

label: Bavarian Illuminati
subtitle: Documented late-eighteenth-century association
description: A historically documented Bavarian organization, kept distinct from modern continuous-global-control claims.

label: Modern Illuminati continuity claim
subtitle: Contested successor claim
description: A later claim that the suppressed Bavarian organization continued as a hidden global body; Atlas does not treat the claim as established history.

label: Satan in later reception
subtitle: Historically changing concept
description: A reception concept whose meanings vary by source and period; it is not a universal alias for every adversarial being.

label: Sacred kingship
subtitle: Ontology concept
description: A comparative concept for religious dimensions of rulership; object-level claims remain source-specific.

label: Scripture and manuscript practice
subtitle: Ontology concept
description: A discovery concept linking physical manuscript facts to religious textual practice without identifying an unspecified leaf with a named work.

label: Stone cuneiform tablet of Ashurnasirpal II
subtitle: Metropolitan Museum of Art 58.31.57
description: An Assyrian royal inscription from Nimrud; it is not a tablet of the Epic of Gilgamesh.

label: Leaf from an illuminated Buddhist manuscript
subtitle: Metropolitan Museum of Art 55.121.37.2
description: A fourteenth-century palm-leaf manuscript object from Nepal; Atlas does not identify it as a Dhammapada witness.
